changes.evidence: In the series finale (S7E13 'What We're Fighting For'), after the Chronicoms are defeated, Simmons and Fitz retire from S.H.I.E.L.D. to raise Alya; a year later Mack tells her his mission is classified because she is no longer an agent. Retiring is a departure under the rules, and the record already marks her 'Retired'.

In Jessica Jones S2 episode 13 ('AKA Playland'), after blackmailing Chao and Benowitz with Malcolm's help, Jeri starts her own firm, Hogarth & Associates, working from home and meeting Pryce Cheng and Malcolm as her new hires. The move happens in S2, not S3.

owner_calls.question: Should this be one record or two? The Agent Carter Sousa (Earth-199999) is killed in 1955. The Sousa saved in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7 is a variant from the timeline the Chronicoms altered, filed by the Marvel Database as Earth-19859.
options: Keep one record (same man up to the 1955 branch point)
Split: Agent Carter Sousa on Earth-199999 (Army, SSR, S.H.I.E.L.D., dies 1955) and AoS S7 Sousa on Earth-19859
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU Wiki main page has DOD July 22, 1955, status Deceased, and MD 'Daniel Sousa (Earth-199999)'. It describes the S7 rescue as saving 'an alternate Sousa'. The variant page 'Daniel Sousa/History Altered by Chronicoms' carries MD 'Daniel Sousa (Earth-19859)'.

owner_calls.question: Does the veterans' support group Curtis runs count as a group? If it does, his last stage would be that group, not Independent, and the Punisher S1 'left' would go.
options: Keep: Navy then Independent (left Punisher S1)
Change the last stage to 'New York Veteran Support Group' from The Punisher S1 and drop the left
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU Wiki lists his affiliations as U.S. Navy (formerly) and New York Veteran Support Group (current). He leads that group throughout The Punisher S1 and S2.
